package.name: pimesh_backend
package.description:
The map, and from P15 the backend that revisits it. Map points observed by many keyframes, the covisibility graph between keyframes, triangulation from those observations, and culling of both — milestone G of #11.
A library and not a node. odometry_node in pimesh_frontend owns the one Map and tracks against it; the frontend turns pixels into correspondences, and this package maintains and optimises what the correspondences are *to*. The two share an object in one process, the way ORB-SLAM's tracker and local mapper do, because the alternative — a backend component finding the map by a string key, as mesh_node finds the TSDF — is the volume_key trap for no gain.
No rclcpp anywhere in it, so every header here is callable from a unit test and every suite runs on the Pi like the rest of the workspace.
